sentences.text: 1. Exemptions allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The applications are disposed of accordingly.

3. The present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C seeks quashing of FIR no. 933/2014, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Model Town and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the respondent no. 2 had settled the dispute with the present petitioner and in pursuance thereto, a decree of divorce was granted on 22.03.2016.
It is submitted that after grant of the said divorce, the respondent no. 2 has not complied with the terms of the settlement arrived at between the parties during the second motion.
6. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

3. The present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C seeks quashing of FIR no. 933/2014, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. It is submitted that after grant of the said divorce, the respondent no. 2 has not complied with the terms of the settlement arrived at between the parties during the second motion.
7. On the petitioner taking necessary steps, issue notice to respondent no. 2 by all permissible modes, including electronic mail, if any, returnable on 24.04.2023.
